title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
Location- Hybrid (Pune/Banglore/Kochi/Mysore)  
Experience: 5 - 7 years  
Budget: 12-13 LPA

**Summary**  
The **Senior DevSecOps Engineer** will design, implement, and manage secure CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud security controls, and automated governance within Azure environments. The role focuses on integrating security throughout the software delivery lifecycle while ensuring compliance with Azure Landing Zone standards and enterprise security requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**  
Design and implement secure CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.  
Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or Bicep.  
Integrate security controls into DevOps workflows (DevSecOps).  
Implement Azure Policy, RBAC, PIM, and governance guardrails.  
Automate security scanning, compliance validation, and secret management.  
Configure and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud.  
Implement monitoring and logging solutions using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.  
Secure application deployments using Managed Identities and Key Vault.  
Collaborate with architects and application teams for workload onboarding.  
Develop operational runbooks, documentation, and security best practices.  
Participate in architecture reviews and security assessments.

**Mandatory Skills**

Azure DevOps  
Terraform and/or Bicep  
Azure Landing Zones (ALZ)  
Azure Policy  
Microsoft Defender for Cloud  
Azure Key Vault  
Azure Monitor & Log Analytics  
RBAC and Privileged Identity Management (PIM)  
Git repositories and branching strategies  
CI/CD pipelines  
SAST, DAST and code scanning tools  
Microsoft Entra ID

**Preferred Skills**  
Azure Verified Modules (AVM)  
ALZ IaC Accelerator  
Container Security (AKS)  
Security Compliance Frameworks  
PowerShell/Python automation  
Sentinel exposure  
**Certifications**  
Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)  
Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)

**Interested candidates can apply through email- hr.sgs.consultancy@gmail.com**

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹108,333.00 per month
